channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kawhi Leonard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kawhi Leonard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scottie Barnes on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Scottie Barnes:

“He’s Kawhi Leonard… He’s going to help us out in so many different ways. He’s a legend in the game. He’s going to be him and that’s obviously going to raise the roof for our team.”

Scottie Barnes on Kawhi Leonard, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Collin Murray-Boyles on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Collin Murray-Boyles on Kawhi Leonard:

“Watching him workout, it’s mesmerizing. He’s been in the league this long and he’s still doing all the little things, still pushing himself to the max. It’s amazing to see for a young player.”

Collin Murray-Boyles on Kawhi Leonard, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett
item.description:
Bobby Webster on if Kawhi Leonard’s extension will have any impact on RJ Barrett’s extension:

“No, I think ownership has been incredibly supportive. So, any time, financially, we want to make a go for it, they’re very supportive.”

Bobby Webster on Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I think wishing that the NBA took $50 million from a player is disgusting. I think it's purely disgusting. I like Gallo, I like Gallo a lot actually, but this is, this is disgusting to me. And the reason this is disgusting because number one, I don't, I don't want anyone getting fined. I think that, I think that shit is whack. You can go back and look where I said if this is true, I hope the punishment is they dismantle the CBA, not take $50 million out of Kawhi Leonard's pocket. That's so whack and I can't believe he said that.”

Draymond Green on Kawhi Leonard, Sep 18, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Kawhi Leonard does not have the power to trade a player. He can request, hey, I want y'all to go out there and get this guy, but he don't have the ability to make that trade. That franchise have to agree, just like they had to agree that they were going to circumvent the cap. He can't make them do that. These are decisions that that franchise made. So in turn, you must have left a big enough impact on that franchise. But to blame another player and say he should have to pay off $50 million back, that shit is whack.”

Draymond Green on Kawhi Leonard, Sep 18, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“We all get a licensing check. LeBron James, Steph Curry, Kawhi Leonard, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokic, they all get the same jersey sales as the rookie. Excuse me, as a rookie, you don't get a license check because the license check is from a year before. But say a second-year guy who didn't play much on a team, and the license check was 500 grand, that's jersey sales. That's all of the licensing things, right? That same 500 grand that that second-year guy gets, Steph Curry gets. It's divvied up, it's even split. And so, you could make 300,000, you could make 500,000, but every player makes the same amount.”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Sep 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Steve Ballmer, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Torre said on the Dan Patrick Show.

“And the NBA said, well in that case, we’re going to do something that perhaps caught Steve Ballmer by surprise. They found a way to settle with Kawhi Leonard and the Players’ Union…They got Kawhi to settle.”

Pablo Torre on Steve Ballmer, Kawhi Leonard, Sep 3, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adam Silver on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
NBA Commissioner Adam Silver on the Kawhi Leonard investigation:

“My timeline remains this summer. I’m not conducting the investigation. ...The league did not pause the trade.”

Adam Silver on Kawhi Leonard, Jul 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Farbod Esnaashari:Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard's upcoming contract:

“I haven't had a chance to think about that after that tough loss. I love the group that we have... Everything is just so fast this season, couldn't really stop and take time to implement what you want to implement.”

Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Apr 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Draymond Green, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard's fourth quarter struggles:

“I thought Draymond did a good job being physical, denying the basketball, not letting him get to his spots... We didn't execute well with his blitzes.”

Tyronn Lue on Draymond Green, Kawhi Leonard, Apr 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kris Dunn on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Clippers guard Kris Dunn told The Athletic of Kawhi Leonard.

“The first thing (Leonard) told (Mathurin) was, ‘Yo, you’re good! This is part of your growth.’And to see something like that from a Hall of Famer, somebody who’s playing at an exceptional level this year, to be able to give Benn that type of confidence to let him know don’t worry about it, that shot is gonna come again, you’ll be prepared … I thought it was major. “And that shows the step right there. Like, OK, he’s taking another step in the leadership role.”

Kris Dunn on Kawhi Leonard, Mar 27, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Tyronn Lue, on Clippers’ half-court success with Kawhi Leonard and Darius Garland:

“I think it comes with great responsibility when you’re Darius and Kawhi. You have to be aggressive scoring ... but you also have to make your teammates better. They’ve been able to do that.”

Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland, Kawhi Leonard, Mar 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Tyronn Lue, on what he’s learned about Kawhi Leonard in their seven years together:

“He’s a winner. He could have easily laid down on us this season, starting 6-21, but he came back with even more fight.... He’s carried us all season long.”

Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Mar 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Anthony Edwards on Kawhi Leonard:

“In all honesty, Kawhi may be one of the best players to ever play the game when he’s healthy. I think a lot of his peers feel the same way about him. When he’s 100%, ain’t no stopping Kawhi”

Anthony Edwards on Kawhi Leonard, Mar 12, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Darius Garland on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
“But yeah, the toe definitely had a factor in it. They didn’t know if I was going to be healthy for this season, which I will be. But they thought that James had something that I didn’t, I believe. He has experience in playoffs and All-Star numbers still to this day, even though he wasn’t an All-Star this year. But yeah, they want to win right now. They have a group, too. And I guess I really wasn’t part of the plan. “But now, I’m over here in a really good situation. I have the ball in my hand a lot more where I could do me a little bit more. I have another superstar [Leonard] next to me. I can go get it as well.”

Darius Garland on Kawhi Leonard, Feb 20, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Darius Garland on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
“When it first happened, I was kind of skeptical. But I couldn’t turn down this opportunity to play with another Hall of Famer [Leonard] and having a ball in my hands damn near 99 percent of the time.”

Darius Garland on Kawhi Leonard, Feb 20, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Ty Lue on giving Kawhi Leonard the game-winning shot:

“Cmon, it’s Kawhi. Game on the line, we know where the ball is going.”

Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Feb 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard’s 28 PPG, 50/40/90 season, while leading the league in steals, and not making the All-Star game:

“Kawhi, to me, the last 6 weeks, has been the best player in the NBA.”

Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Collins on James Harden, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Collins:

“Consistency. You can count on them to come up big in big moments. I feel like that means just as much as anything, as any part of basketball. If you need somebody to step up or you need somebody to call upon, I feel like those two dudes are so equipped and so experienced for any situation. That sort of relaxes me a little bit. Just being able to look over there and see Kawhi Leonard and James Harden and know that those guys have been through the trenches and are still here and staying strong. These ‘Uncs’ can still hoop. They’re still going hard. They’re still at the top of their game. Of course, some hometown nods shouldn’t hurt.”

John Collins on James Harden, Kawhi Leonard, Jan 27, 2026. Source: Essentially Sports.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Joey Linn:Jaylen Brown on Kawhi Leonard:

“I think Kawhi is one of the best two-way players of all-time. Offense and defense. His ability to take over a game. His defensive versatility, his offensive versatility. He’s derailed by injuries but people don’t understand how much effort it takes to put so much energy on both sides of the ball. Can easily just focus on offense and focus your energy on offense, but somebody who gives their all on offense and defense has wear and tear on their body. He was derailed by injuries, but in his prime in his peak he’s one of the best two-way players of all-time in my opinion.”

Jaylen Brown on Kawhi Leonard, Jan 4, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Tyronn Lue, on what he’s seen turn things around:

“Now with the minutes restriction [for Kawhi Leonard] off, being able to play 38 to 40 minutes every night, that really gives us a real chance every single night offensively. And then defensively, we know what he can do as well.”

Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Dec 29, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard:

“He did a few things... he's definitely gotten better. I mean, I don't know how long it's gonna be. But he's definitely gotten better. Just seeing him on the floor yesterday was really good to see.”

Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Nov 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: James Harden on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
James Harden on Kawhi Leonard:

“He's been putting the work in all summer. He's been aggressive. He looks like Kawhi, which is beneficial for our team.”

James Harden on Kawhi Leonard, Oct 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Chris Mannix:Pascal Siakam, on what he learned from @Kawhi Leonard:

“Being even-keeled. I think Kawhi, no matter what happened, he is always the same. That's something I try to have for me. It's like no matter good or bad, make shots, miss shots, it doesn't really matter. Just be yourself.”

Pascal Siakam on Kawhi Leonard, Jun 21, 2025. Source: Twitter @SIChrisMannix.

item.title: James Harden on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Justin Russo:James Harden on Kawhi Leonard:

“He loves to hoop. As you can see, when he's on the court, he's a killer. I'm glad he's in a good space right now.”

James Harden on Kawhi Leonard, Apr 22, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Kris Dunn, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Michael Porter Jr on maybe seeing Kawhi Leonard matched up on him:

“Amazing on-ball defender. It’s gonna be fun for me just because he is one of the best defenders in the NBA.I think that they’ll mix it up. They’ll probably put Kris Dunn and Kawhi back & forth on me and Jamal.”

Michael Porter Jr on Kris Dunn, Kawhi Leonard, Apr 17, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on James Harden, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Justin Russo:Bogdan Bogdanovic on earning trust of Kawhi Leonard and James Harden:

“I’m just looking where is the space to attack and having them on the floor makes the job easier. You just look around and see where to attack, where is our advantage. It’s everywhere, but where’s our biggest advantage?”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on James Harden, Kawhi Leonard, Mar 8, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard stepping away amid wildfires:

“You definitely have to take care of home. ... Totally had my support 100%.Going back, checking on his family and kids, making sure they're well. And he got back, and they're doing OK, so just happy and thankful for that.”

Tyronn Lue on Kawhi Leonard, Jan 8, 2025. Source: Twitter.
